title: Alert rule quality policy: legacy string FieldRequirement must still unmarshal
answers: Old AlertRuleQualityPolicy / dev quality policies fail to read or error out after upgrade
requiredAnnotations or requiredLabels stored as plain strings break the API
How to make a CRD field type change backwards compatible for already-stored resources
body:
Symptom: existing AlertRuleQualityPolicy resources (requiredAnnotations/requiredLabels) fail to be read from storage after upgrading, blocking removal of old dev policies.
Root cause: FieldRequirement was changed from a plain JSON string to a struct {Key, Enforce} (grafana/grafana#132549), so previously persisted string-encoded values no longer match the new struct shape during unmarshal.
Fix pattern: add a custom UnmarshalJSON on the changed type that detects the legacy encoding (e.g. leading `"` byte means a bare string) and converts it into the new struct with a hardcoded legacy default (Enforce: true), falling back to normal struct unmarshal for the new shape. See apps/alerting/alertrulequality/pkg/apis/alertrulequality/v0alpha1/field_requirement_json.go:UnmarshalJSON.
Constraints: applies when a CRD/app-platform type's on-the-wire field shape changes and instances already exist in unified storage; verify end-to-end via apistore.NewStorage/store.Get as in pkg/storage/unified/apistore/alertrulequality_test.go. Not needed for new fields with no persisted data. This is meant to be temporary — removed once legacy data is cleared.
applies: apps/alerting/alertrulequality and any Grafana app-platform type whose field JSON shape changes after data already exists in unified storage
